name: large_funcs
description: Functions/methods longer than N lines (py/go/js/ts/rs) as data, sorted by length; best-effort

path.description: directory or file to scan (default: project root)

min_lines.description: report functions with at least this many lines (default 60)

lang.description: restrict to one language (default any; ts/tsx count as js)

funcs.name: str
funcs.confidence: num 0..1 per language (py indent 0.95, go/rs braces 0.85, js 0.7)
